transcript.text: I need to share what commercial finance has found. I completed a reconciliation of invoices and shipment records after the latest quarter closed, and it shows that the reseller underpaid exactly $186,400. The agreement's audit clause permits an audit when the reported royalty discrepancy is at least 5%, and our reconciliation shows a 7.8% discrepancy. Since 7.8% exceeds the 5% threshold, I believe the company should exercise the audit right immediately rather than merely preserving it in reserve. I should note that I haven't uploaded the reconciliation to the matter file yet because finance is still completing its month-end close.
